extracted.name: Chicken & Shrimp Pasta Bake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chicken & Shrimp Pasta Bake.
instruction_lines: Season Chicken Breast with garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, black pepper & paprika
Season Shrimp with chili powder & all purpose seasoning
Add olive oil to a skillet & cook chicken breast until fully cooked, then remove from skillet
Using the same skillet, cook shrimp 2 minutes on both sides, then remove from skillet
Boil pasta noodles until desired doneness
Add a half stick of butter to the skillet & 1 tablespoon of minced garlic
Add 2 cups of heavy whipping cream, 2 cups of shredded Parmesan & 1 cup of shredded mozzarella, then stir
Season cheese mixture with Cajun Seasoning & black pepper, then stir
Add in broccoli florets to the skillet
Add pasta noodles to the skillet
Add diced chicken to the skillet
Turn off heat and add shrimp to the skillet
Add pasta to a baking dish & top with shredded mozzarella cheese & parsley flakes
